column1: # Declared relations between clause fingerprints, over the corpus formed by every clause's own
# fixtures. tests/test_occasion_algebra.py computes each fingerprint's extension and fails on a
# relation that is NOT declared here, on a declared relation that no longer holds, and on a live
# Overlap is DECLARED, never condemned. Three of the four rows below are a general clause layered
# with a specific one -- A01 guards a push nobody checked, A03 a force-push nobody fetched -- and a
# check that condemned subsumption outright would fire on all three. A gate firing on lookalikes is
# itself Asymmetric: the noise does not heal, the gate gets disabled, and its real catches go with it.
# RELATION is read left-to-right: A SUPERSET B means every command matching B also matches A.
# WITNESS is a command in the shared extension and must still be matched by BOTH, so a fingerprint
# edit breaks the row rather than silently re-pointing it.

column5: layering, not duplication: A01 denies a push whose landing nobody checked (discharge: git status), A03 a force-push whose remote tip was never fetched (discharge: git fetch). Different obligations on one command; A03 is quarantined, so no live double-denial.
the general/specific pair: U12 takes session_id as subject, U13 extracts the patch file as its own. Both quarantined.

identical extension on this corpus only: U02's pattern is strictly narrower (it requires arguments), and no fixture exercises the difference. Both quarantined; if either is ever unquarantined, this row needs a fixture that separates them.

THE ONE LIVE PAIR, and a real defect rather than layering. A02 denies a bulk delete over a set nobody enumerated (subject: the path; discharge: ls|find|git status|du); U20 denies a destructive mutation nobody tested (subject: session_id; discharge: pytest|curl). One command raises two denials with unrelated remedies. Independently measured at 32 of 64 calls over 2266 real Bash calls, where the relation is strict subsumption rather than partial overlap.
